_comment: The 20 courses of the Track Design Bible (mutant-plan/strategy/2caves2qud-tracks) as engine data, generated by tools/qud_tracks.py — edit THAT and rerun. Coordinates are unscaled world px; both paths apply tuning.race.track_scale. tileset/offroad/wallset are Qud biomes (tools/export_godot_assets.py TILESETS). hazards: fixed surface patches at route fractions (kind ice|fire|poison|water|oil|slime|static, at 0..1, side -1..1 of the road, radius px). 'spells' are the Qud items that appear on the course as scrolls. 'gaps' lists what the bible asks for that the engine cannot build yet.

tracks.name: Joppa Waterwheel Run
tracks.sentence: Circle Joppa's watervine farms, cut through its briny shallows, and time the rotating waterwheel gate on the way back to the village square.

lap_notes.3: a gap opens in the paddles

tracks.name: Red Rock Ramble
tracks.sentence: Drop through Red Rock's canyon strata, race beside the underground river, and climb a switchback tunnel while baboon-thrown stones alter the best line.
gaps: baboon stone throws with shadow targets
cavern bridges and the arch jump

lap_notes.2: the baboons aim for the racing lane

tracks.name: Rust Wells Spiral
tracks.sentence: Spiral around three chrome-lined Rust Wells while corrosive qudzu narrows the inside and hanging wire offers risky aerial transfers.

lap_notes.2: a bridge panel collapses: take the outer bypass
lap_notes.3: the gap is jumpable: pad before the break

tracks.name: Six Day Stilt Pilgrimage
tracks.sentence: Follow a pilgrim's loop across the salt dunes and through the Six Day Stilt's bazaar, where merchant traffic reshapes wide but readable lanes around the cathedral.
gaps: three bazaar aisles with merchant traffic by lap

lap_notes.2: the left aisle fills with carts
lap_notes.3: the market turns: right aisle busy

tracks.name: Grit Gate Grand Prix
tracks.sentence: Thread ruined approaches and the Barathrumite enclave while cycling force barriers alternately open a fast atrium line and a safer service tunnel.
gaps: cycling force barriers (upper corridor vs service tunnel)
communications panel that inverts the cycle

tracks.name: Asphalt Mines Slick
tracks.sentence: Descend an abandoned asphalt mine where sticky black pools punish cuts, rainbow oil enables long slides, and a deep lava gallery powers the climb home.
gaps: two-level shaft descent and turbine lift

lap_notes.2: an oil ribbon leaks across the causeway
lap_notes.3: a second ribbon: chain the slides

tracks.name: Golgotha Drop
tracks.sentence: Commit to a one-way plunge through Golgotha's conveyor-fed trash chutes, dodge vent cycles, and outrun the refuse into the Cloaca.
gaps: one-way section race with four chute mouths

lap_notes.2: the belts run faster: vents ahead

tracks.name: Bethesda Susa Deep Freeze
tracks.sentence: Descend Bethesda Susa as every sector grows colder, earn three gate keys through racing lines, and survive the cryobarrios before the warm Temple of the Rock.
gaps: three keyed gates from arena tokens

tracks.name: Kyakukya Cap Circuit
tracks.sentence: Bank around Kyakukya's giant mushroom dwellings, skim its jungle pools, and slalom past a monumental ape statue as springy caps reshape jump timing.
gaps: springy mushroom-cap jumps on a beat
root ramp to the upper village

lap_notes.2: the middle cap falls off the beat

tracks.name: Rainbow Wood Soupway
tracks.sentence: Navigate Rainbow Wood's fungus corridors while colored weeps feed primordial-soup rivers and every new liquid mixture grows a different temporary slalom.
gaps: colored weeps mixing into soup rivers

lap_notes.2: the yellow weep joins the soup

tracks.name: Chavvah Canopy Climb
tracks.sentence: Climb the inhabited branches of Chavvah on spiral stairs and crystalline limbs, then dive through the canopy while the roaming tree gently changes its lean.

lap_notes.2: the tree leans toward the branch transfer
lap_notes.3: the tree leans back to the terrace

tracks.name: Eyn Roj Dreamroot
tracks.sentence: Dive beneath Eyn Roj through crystalline roots where psychic echoes show several possible roads but only solid rhythm rock marks the immediate racing line.
gaps: psychic overlays (doubled edges, false silhouettes, ghost racers)

tracks.name: Lake Hinnom Causeway
tracks.sentence: Race broken causeways across Lake Hinnom, using giant clams as timed jump pads while enormous reef creatures reshape the open-water current.
gaps: giant clam jump pads on a cycle

tracks.name: Palladium Reef Polyp Maze
tracks.sentence: Thread the Palladium Reef's old arcology while translucent struts interrupt distant sightlines and plucked polyps expose brief sunslag boost pockets.
gaps: sunslag polyp boost pockets per lap

tracks.name: Yd Freehold Pipeworks
tracks.format: 3-lap circuit with parallel rooms (run as one line)
tracks.sentence: Follow Yd Freehold's dyed pipework through a lyrical surface community and choose among parallel underground rooms that trade speed, items, and technical difficulty.
gaps: Many Eyes chamber and corkscrew pipe

lap_notes.3: the pipes light a surface bypass

tracks.name: Moon Stair Static Circuit
tracks.sentence: Climb a black-marble maze of hexagonal crystal while warm static announces one changed racing rule per lap and broken prisms release mirrored rival echoes.
gaps: one announced rule change per lap

tracks.name: The Hydropon Bloom
tracks.sentence: Sprint around the hydroponic cradle as sunslag-fed lilies grow new banked leaves each lap and gradually open a faster route across the center.
gaps: leaves growing per lap to open the center route

tracks.name: Omonporch Twin Gates
tracks.sentence: Sweep through Omonporch's sultan court and banana groves, then ride the Spindle's magnetic pull up a blue wall before diving past the sealed Twin Gates.
gaps: magnetic roadway up the Spindle with release windows

tracks.name: Tomb of the Eaters Bell Run
tracks.sentence: Ascend the Tomb of the Eaters from bone catacombs through its lethal crematory, reaching checkered Places of Rest before each Bell pulse displaces exposed racers.
gaps: the Bell clock and checkered sanctuaries

lap_notes.3: press, arm, vent, fan at once

tracks.name: Thin World Crossing
tracks.sentence: Cross the Thin World on a road that recomposes from solid azzurum to holographic geometry, where falling cannot end the race but returns the kart through a different line.

lap_notes.2: the road thins: the void shows through

tracks.name: Chicago Loop
tracks.sentence: A random closed route through the Chicago Loop's real streets, sealed with Qud brick.
